mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.tracking_record (tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_company_id, consignee_company_id, booking_status, routing_case_number, route_version_no, current_status, original_eta, latest_eta, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{consigneeCompanyId}, #{bookingStatus}, #{routingCaseNumber}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{currentStatus}, #{originalEta}, #{latestEta}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO tracking.scheduled_leg (tracking_number, leg_no, voyage_number, load_unlocode, discharge_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{legNo}, #{voyageNumber}, #{loadUnlocode}, #{dischargeUnlocode}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_company_id, consignee_company_id, booking_status, routing_case_number, route_version_no, current_status, original_eta, latest_eta, version, created_at, updated_at FROM tracking.tracking_record WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}

SELECT tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_company_id, consignee_company_id, booking_status, routing_case_number, route_version_no, current_status, original_eta, latest_eta, version, created_at, updated_at FROM tracking.tracking_record WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
SELECT tracking_number, current_status, original_eta, created_at FROM tracking.tracking_record ORDER BY created_at DESC, tracking_number LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tracking_number, leg_no, voyage_number, load_unlocode, discharge_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at FROM tracking.scheduled_leg WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} ORDER BY leg_no
